repository.name: agid-postal-il
repository.purpose: Israel postal-context contract seed for an independent country-data repository linked to AGID

postal_system.assignment_rule: Israel Post defines the postcode as seven digits representing the address for mail delivery, assigned by the company and updated from time to time. Store it as a seven-character digit string. Production assignment requires an exact current Israel Post response or separately licensed release with the postal object type, authority, validity, retrieval time, schema and digest pinned. A UPU example, GovMap result, government street, locality, CBS geography, coordinate, parcel, OSM feature, model or proximity does not create an assignment.
postal_system.geometry_rule: A seven-digit code is opaque and may identify an address, route, P.O. Box, delivery centre, large recipient, point or other non-area object. Never generate an official polygon from code digits, a single point or containment. Official postal geometry requires an exact separately licensed Israel Post artifact that explicitly relates the code to geometry and pins validity, CRS, topology and digest. GovMap, CBS, municipal, parcel, street, OSM, Voronoi, interpolation and model geometry remain independent candidate, administrative, community or derived surfaces.
postal_system.distribution_code_rule: The Israel Post mail guide defines a separate nine-digit distribution code for bulk-mail delivery ordering. It must not be normalized, displayed, indexed or promoted as the seven-digit postcode.
postal_system.address_rule: Recipient, organisation, street, house number, entrance, floor, apartment or unit, locality, P.O. Box, postcode, coordinates and delivery objects remain typed, sourced and validity-aware. Search results and coordinates do not identify a recipient, resident, owner, occupant, legal unit, entrance, exact civic-address identity, building relation or delivery entitlement.
postal_system.building_rule: Building display requires an explicit rights-cleared civic-address identifier, a stable reviewed relation to a building identifier, and separately permitted building geometry with purpose, validity, privacy, CRS and digests pinned. GovMap search, Data.gov.il catalog presence, street lists, CBS geography, parcels and OSM buildings are not automatic address-building relations. Postal or administrative containment and nearest-building logic are candidate or validation evidence only.
postal_system.agid_rule: AGID remains an independent spatial index. Postal assignments, official or derived surfaces, address points and buildings may link to AGID cells through explicit versioned crosswalks without relabelling a postcode, distribution code, address, locality, administrative unit, parcel, P.O. Box, building or territory as an AGID cell, or claiming AGID geometry is Israel Post geometry.
postal_system.licence_rule: Israel Post website terms state that information is informational only, not binding, must not be relied on for official or commercial use, and is all-rights-reserved; lookup or guide access is not redistribution permission. For Data.gov.il, pin the exact dataset, resource, publisher, terms effective at retrieval and any item-specific override. Default terms allow reuse with attribution but exclude or restrict privacy violations, misleading or unlawful use, third-party rights, software and protected systems. GovMap and CBS artifacts require their own exact terms or licence. ODbL data remains separate.
postal_system.privacy_rule: Recipients, senders, postcode or address queries, home and apartment numbers, entrances, private coordinates, P.O. Box holders, phone or email, identities, residents, owners, occupants, tenants, credentials and private premises are excluded from public artifacts. Exact lawful authority, purpose limitation, minimisation, retention and publication approval are required before operational postal or partner address data enter a production pack.
postal_system.territorial_rule: Country code IL selects a runtime and source contract; it is not a territorial or sovereignty assertion. The UPU 10/2022 routing note concerning items to localities under the Palestinian Authority is preserved only as cross-border mail-routing metadata and cannot create IL postal assignments, coverage, polygons, boundaries or AGID territory. Separate source-scoped packs and explicit versioned crosswalks are required.
